These reflect greater cellular irregularity, higher proliferation rates, and more complex tumor architecture. Fractal dimension, which measures surface complexity, is also elevated in malignancies. The worst metrics (e.g., worst radius, worst concavity) are especially sensitive indicators of malignancy because they represent the most severe characteristics of the tumor. Thus, these features are known to be elevated in malignant tumors.
